Batch Edit Guide:

• All fields default to "<keep>", meaning that field will not be changed 
• Editing a field applies its value to all selected songs 
• Tap the undo button next to a field to restore it to "<keep>" 
• For rating, tap the stars to set a new rating, or tap Undo to keep it unchanged 
• Tap the cover to change or remove it 
• Tap Save to write the changes to the file tags of all selected songs
